changes.comment: Fix a FormStateNode bound to a collection reporting valid while its data control held a validation error. Errors are mirrored from the data control onto the node's base control, but appending child nodes rewrites base's value, which cleared them because keepErrors was unimplemented in @rx-controls/core. A collection over its Length.max now reports the node (and the root) invalid, so submit and wizard validity gates see it.
